glossary.definition: A single end-to-end emergency call attempt initiated by the TCU, comprising connection setup, minimum voice duration, and mandatory vehicle data transmission to the Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP).

business_rules.rule: An eCall session must maintain an open voice channel for a minimum of 120 seconds; if the connection is dropped before this threshold, the TCU must automatically retry up to three times with a 30-second interval between attempts.
